rules.title: RSO annual allowable rent increase (3%)
rules.requirement: For units subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, the annual allowable rent increase is 3% for the period July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); the page directs users to ZIMAS to determine whether a unit is RSO.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) – LAHD RSO Rent Increase Calculator
rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.
rules.ambiguity_note: The stated 3% figure applies to a period ending 2026-06-30, which is before the 2026-10-01 status date; the page still displays it and no later figure is given.

rules.title: No additional utility percentage increase for RSO units
rules.requirement: Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords of RSO units can no longer add any additional percentage rent increase for utilities on top of the annual allowable increase.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) – LAHD RSO Rent Increase Calculator
rules.quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
